# BarChart

Compare one value across categories — RAM per instance, disk per pool, backups per day.

`KenosUI.BarChart` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.BarChart data={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.BarChart" data="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One series of bars (≤ 24px thick, rounded data end), values at the tip, hover + focus per bar, table view.
